description: This Java class implements a substitution strategy for modifying Thing objects within a system that uses Ditto for IoT device management. It handles substitution of access control lists and policies within a ModifyThing command, supporting placeholder replacements based on headers and other context.

classes.name: ModifyThingSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractTypedSubstitutionStrategy specialized for ModifyThing objects, responsible for applying header-based substitutions to modify commands involving Thing objects.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the substitution strategy to a given ModifyThing command, optionally replacing the involved Thing and Policy JSON objects if changes are detected.

methods.name: substituteInitialPolicy
methods.description: Parses and substitutes placeholders within an initial policy JsonObject, handling parsing exceptions with logging.
